SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, first_fiscal_week, last_fiscal_week, fully_loaded
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' ORDER BY fiscal_period

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.quantity AS units
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.quantity_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.brand, cp.category, cp.subcategory,
       SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.units) AS net_units
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 15

           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT (SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS mine,
       (SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND store_id <> 999) AS control,
       (SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS control_all,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_lines,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_ids

UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_name_among_current', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT product_name FROM dim_product WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sku)>1)
